title: a16z Podcast: The Taxonomy of Collective Knowledge

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: What do disease diagnostics, language learning, and image recognition have in common?
reader_summary.overview: What do disease diagnostics, language learning, and image recognition have in common? All depend on the organization of collective intelligence: data ontologies. In this episode of the a16z Podcast, guests Luis von Ahn, founder of reCaptcha and Duolingo, Jay Komarneni, founder of HumanDX, a16z General Partner Vijay Pande.

key_points.text: In this episode of the a16z Podcast, guests Luis von Ahn, founder of reCaptcha and Duolingo, Jay Komarneni, founder of HumanDX.
It is data ontologies, in fact, that enable not only human computation -- but that allow us to map out, structure.
